plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomous experiment loop for ZCode: set a goal, pick a mechanical metric, and let the agent iterate — measure, keep what works, revert what doesn't, repeat. Provides init/run/log experiment tools (MCP), a loop protocol skill, guardrails (frozen benchmark, checks backpressure, memory injection, Stop continuation), and a static dashboard export.
